instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Overview of CivicParcel Collection Passage: It releases completed service documents to Applicants or their named Authorized Collectors and closes each request after acknowledged handover. The Applicant submits the request and names an Authorized Collector when another person will collect. The Records Clerk confirms readiness and verifies the collector, while the Authorized Collector provides the reference and acknowledges receipt at handover. The Counter Officer records the document and collector, and the Service Supervisor closes the request only after acknowledgement. Application assessment and mail delivery are excluded.

output.summary: CivicParcel Collection Passage releases completed service documents to Applicants or named Authorized Collectors and closes requests after acknowledged handover. The Applicant submits the request and names an Authorized Collector when needed, and the Records Clerk confirms readiness and collector authority. The Authorized Collector provides the collection reference and acknowledges receipt, while the Counter Officer records the handover details. The Service Supervisor closes the request only after acknowledgement; application assessment and mail delivery are excluded.
output.primary_goal: Release completed service documents to Applicants or their named Authorized Collectors and close each request after acknowledged handover.
key_capabilities: Submit a collection request and name an Authorized Collector when needed.
Confirm document readiness and verify collector authority.
Provide the collection reference and acknowledge receipt at handover.
Record the document handed over and the collector.
Close the request only after receipt is acknowledged.
